title: Sample: the line that opens the video
hooks: Sample hook one. This is where the first line of the video goes.
Sample hook two, a different angle on the same idea.
body:
### Explain
This is preview data so the page can be looked at before sign-in exists. Real scripts live behind sign-in.

### Illustrate
A short story that makes the point concrete. Two or three sentences.

### Lesson
- One takeaway.
- A second takeaway.
- Something they can do tomorrow.

End on the **one line you want remembered.**
broll:
- Hands on the keyboard
- Chart on the second screen

title: Sample: a story card
body:
A 60-second structure. Speak it in your own words, hit each beat in order.

### 1. Hook (0 to 5s)
Call out the person directly.

### 2. The turn (5 to 30s)
What happened, what it cost.

### 3. Close (30 to 60s)
The line that lands.
